notes:
SCOPE & METHOD: Department rosters for MP/CG/RJ were built from the current council-of-ministers portfolio lists on English Wikipedia ('Mohan Yadav ministry', 'Vishnu Deo Sai ministry', 'Bhajan Lal Sharma ministry' infobox tables, fetched 2026-09-25), not from each state's official 'Allocation/Distribution of Business' notification, because mp.gov.in, cg.gov.in and rajasthan.gov.in department-directory pages are client-side-rendered (JS/Angular SPAs) and returned no department list to curl/WebFetch, and this session's WebSearch budget (200/200) was already exhausted by other segments' agents before this task started, so an alternative search for the gazette PDF was not possible. Coverage is therefore the full active cabinet portfolio set (44 MP / 41 CG / 50 RJ departments) rather than a verified line-by-line government Business Rules list; some very small/technical departments that don't appear as a distinct named portfolio in the ministry infobox (e.g. some directorates) may be missing, and a couple of adjacent portfolios were merged into one department entity where Wikipedia listed them as a single minister responsibility (e.g. MP 'Industrial Policy and Investment Promotion'). Confidence is 'medium' throughout for this reason, not 'high'.

SECRETARIES (task item 2): NOT INCLUDED. Administrative Secretary / Principal Secretary / ACS postings need a 2025-2026 GAD transfer-order list per state; mp.gov.in's GAD MIS/CSMIS pages (gad.mp.gov.in) render no personnel data via curl/WebFetch, cg.gov.in did not resolve (connection failed, HTTP 000), and rajasthan.gov.in/directory is also client-rendered. With WebSearch exhausted, no reliable current-officer source was found, so per SCHEMA.md guidance ('If you cannot confirm a holder... omit the position rather than guessing') the positions array is empty. Needs a dedicated follow-up pass with a fresh WebSearch budget against each state's GAD transfer-order PDFs or an IAS-officer directory.

HEAD-POSITION-ID GAPS: headPositionId/the 'heads' relation was only set where the minister is the Chief Minister or a Deputy CM, because those are the only st-<code>-pos-* minister IDs that exist yet in data/raw/states-mp-cg-rj.json — no st-<code>-pos-minister-<n> positions have been created for the ~15-20 other cabinet/MoS ministers per state (confirmed by loading states-mp-cg-rj.json and every other states-*.json before starting: none exist for MP/CG/RJ).
